trust_decision.summary: Box sizes read from an untrusted moov-recovery (.mrf) file are trusted as lengths for fseek/malloc/fread/rewrite when qtmoovrecover rebuilds a MOV; at the pinned commit atomsrecovery.c already rejects size<8 and child-past-parent boxes, and the listed fix commit is only the 1.28.5 release commit with no source change.

landing_point.why: moov_recov_file_create is the only parser of .mrf files (the only source file using the MRF name besides its header and examples); the summary says 'MRF File Parsing'.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: unknown: the published fix diff has no source change, so no route can be compared against it; the box-size validation is already present at the pinned commit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: dinf box skipped with auxsize-8 after the hdlr branch; a copy that drops the size check on this second read would be a realistic missing-guard sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every box reader repeats the same read_atom_header + 'size < 8' pattern by hand; one copy losing its guard in the hdlr branch is a plausible maintainer slip.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: new stbl/minf/mdia/trak sizes and trak_data_size are derived from file-supplied sizes and offsets before g_malloc/fread; dropping the containment checks at 586, 646, 718 or 763 would reopen it.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The size arithmetic lives far from the parse-time checks (write path vs parse path), so a maintainer could validate in one and not the other.

O9_family: memory-safety: heap overflow from untrusted container box length (CWE-122)

O10_build.toolchain: meson + ninja, GLib/GStreamer core and gst-plugins-good isomp4 plugin
O10_build.project_tests: unknown: no test referencing qtmoovrecover or atomsrecovery found under subprojects/gst-plugins-good outside the element sources and docs cache
